data.title: 白金 · 烛影摇曳的榻上依偎
data.description: 【静谧深闺卧室·深夜】暖调香薰烛光在丝绒软榻旁静静摇曳。白金侧卧在深色床单上，单手支着下巴，冰蓝细吊带衬托出优美的腰线与背部线条。她指尖轻轻勾弄着你的衣襟，低声诉说着卸下刺客面具后的真实心事。
data.action: 侧卧倚枕伸手轻勾衣襟低语
data.lighting: 床头琥珀色香薰烛光跳动弱光
data.promptProse: Lying gracefully on her side across dark velvet bedding in a quiet bedroom at night, Platinum rests her cheek on a pillow and reaches gently toward the viewer with an unguarded smile. Warm flickering candlelight glints over her ice-blue silk slip dress with slender spaghetti straps, scalloped lace trim, and high side slit.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her side on dark bedding in an ice-blue lace-trimmed silk slip dress, she rests her cheek against the pillow and reaches out with a soft, intimate smile. Flickering bedside candlelight traces warm amber highlights along her collarbone and silk folds.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an ice-blue silk slip dress with slender spaghetti straps, scalloped lace neckline trim, an open back, and a high side slit.
